caption: The drawing depicts a single blue candle holder centered on an off-white or beige background. The candle holder is illustrated with a translucent, glass-like appearance, featuring multiple curved and rounded bulges along its stem and a wide, fluted base. The base has distinct vertical grooves that create a petal-like pattern, giving it a symmetrical look. The colors used for the candle holder are shades of light blue and teal, with white highlights and subtle gray shading to convey its reflective, glassy surface. There are no other objects or decorations present in the drawing, and the background remains plain and unadorned.
title: Candlestick
